questions.question: A man borrows a sum of ₹1,025 and pays back in two equal yearly instalments. If the rate of interest is 5% p.a, compounded yearly, then how much is each instalments?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Rate 5% = 1/20 → Ratio for 1st year = 20 : 21 and 2nd year = 20² : 21² = 400 : 441.

To make installments equal, multiply 1st ratio by 21: (20 × 21) : (21 × 21) = 420 : 441.

Total Principal = 420 + 400 = 820 units.

Given, 820 units = ₹1,025 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹1025 ÷ 820 = ₹1.25.

Each installment = 441 units = 441 × 1.25 = ₹551.25.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹551.25.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1,025

Rate (R) = 5% p.a.

Number of installments (n) = 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f66c2d9577453575157cf0050dab652189b6c830c0aba8226d8e8efe0c1eac5.png] 

**Formula Used:**

P = x ÷ (1 + r/100) + x ÷ (1 + r/100)²

Where x = value of each installment, r = rate of interest, P = sum borrowed.

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1025 = x ÷ (1 + 5/100) + x ÷ (1 + 5/100)²

⇒ 1025 = x ÷ (21/20) + x ÷ (441/400)

⇒ 1025 = 20x/21 + 400x/441

⇒ 1025 = (420x + 400x) ÷ 441

⇒ 1025 = 820x ÷ 441

⇒ x = (1025 × 441) ÷ 820

⇒ x = (1.25) × 441

⇒ x = 551.25

**∴ The correct answer is ₹551.25.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Installment Formula

For n years, the sum P is given by P = x[1/k + 1/k² + ... + 1/kⁿ], where k = (1 + r/100).

Simple Interest Installment

For SI, the formula is P = [100x × n + (r × x × n(n−1)/2)] ÷ 100.

Effective Rate for 2 Years

The effective compound interest rate for two years is calculated as (r + r + (r×r)/100)%.

questions.question: The LCM of x² - 8x + 15 and x² - 5x + 6 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Factorize both quadratic expressions by identifying the factors of the constant term that sum to the middle coefficient.

x² − 8x + 15 → Factors of 15 that sum to −8 are −3 and −5 → (x − 3)(x − 5)

x² − 5x + 6 → Factors of 6 that sum to −5 are −2 and −3 → (x − 3)(x − 2)

LCM is the product of all unique factors appearing in the expressions: (x − 3), (x − 5), and (x − 2).

**∴ The correct answer is (x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given expressions:

P(x) = x² − 8x + 15

Q(x) = x² − 5x + 6

To find the LCM, we first factorize each polynomial completely.

⇒ P(x) = x² − 5x − 3x + 15

⇒ P(x) = x(x − 5) − 3(x − 5) = (x − 5)(x − 3)

⇒ Q(x) = x² − 3x − 2x + 6

⇒ Q(x) = x(x − 3) − 2(x − 3) = (x − 3)(x − 2)

⇒ LCM is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors present in the expressions.

⇒ LCM [P(x), Q(x)] = (x − 3)¹ × (x − 5)¹ × (x − 2)¹

⇒ LCM = (x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 3)

**∴ The correct answer is (x − 5)(x − 2)(x − 3).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF of Polynomials

The Highest Common Factor (HCF) is the product of common factors with the lowest power. Here, the common factor is (x − 3), so HCF = (x − 3).

Relation between HCF and LCM

For any two polynomials P(x) and Q(x), the relationship is: P(x) × Q(x) = HCF(P, Q) × LCM(P, Q).

Factoring Quadratic Trinomials

A quadratic trinomial x² + bx + c is factored into (x + p)(x + q) where p × q = c and p + q = b.</p

questions.question: Seenu has invested 40% of his money at 25% per annum and the rest at 20% per annum. What would be the annual rate of interest, if the interest is calculated on the whole sum?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Investment ratio = 40% : (100% − 40%) = 40 : 60 = 2 : 3

Weighted Average Rate = [(Ratio 1 × Rate 1) + (Ratio 2 × Rate 2)] ÷ (Sum of Ratios)

Average Rate = [(2 × 25) + (3 × 20)] ÷ (2 + 3)

Average Rate = (50 + 60) ÷ 5 = 110 ÷ 5 = 22%

**∴ The correct answer is 22%.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Investment 1 = 40% of Sum at 25% p.a.

Investment 2 = 60% of Sum at 20% p.a.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f8cbb9fec917c0341523ff6f1cc7adbe99da0908613df0b2759cf1fec639eb7.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total investment sum be ₹100.

⇒ Sum 1 = 40% of ₹100 = ₹40

⇒ Annual Interest from Sum 1 = 40 × (25 ÷ 100) = ₹10

⇒ Sum 2 = 60% of ₹100 = ₹60

⇒ Annual Interest from Sum 2 = 60 × (20 ÷ 100) = ₹12

⇒ Total annual interest = ₹10 + ₹12 = ₹22

⇒ Annual rate of interest on whole sum = (Total Interest ÷ Total Sum) × 100

⇒ Annual rate = (22 ÷ 100) × 100 = 22%

**∴ The correct answer is 22%.**

**__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Formula

The combined average of two or more groups is given by: (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the quantity and x is the rate/average.

Alligation Rule

It is used to find the ratio in which two quantities at different prices or rates must be mixed to produce a mixture of a given mean price/rate.

Simple Interest Principle

Annual rate of interest remains constant if calculated on the same principal amount over the entire period using SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

questions.question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3500 as a sum borrowed at 7% per year rate of interest for 5 years.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Effective Interest % = Rate × Time = 7% × 5 = 35%

Simple Interest = 35% of Principal = 0.35 × 3500

Simple Interest = 35 × 35 = 1225

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1225.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Principal (P) = ₹3500

Rate of interest (R) = 7% per annum

Time (T) = 5 years

Formula used: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f22888986432ca6647489e8bd77b8722a9d0d2dc833ebda642b409300277963.png] 

Calculations:

⇒ SI = (3500 × 7 × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (3500 × 35) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 35 × 35

⇒ SI = 1225

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1225.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

Amount (A) is the sum of Principal and Simple Interest. A = P + SI = P × (1 + RT/100).

Calculating Rate or Time

From the SI formula, Rate (R) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T) and Time (T) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × R).

Constant Interest Property

In Simple Interest, the interest earned remains the same every year because the principal remains unchanged throughout the duration.

questions.question: The expression (tan θ + cot θ) (sec θ + tan θ) (1 – sin θ), 0° < θ < 90°, is equal to:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use the value substitution method by picking a specific angle, let θ = 30°.

Substitute values: tan 30° = 1/√3, cot 30° = √3, sec 30° = 2/√3, sin 30° = 1/2.

Expression = (1/√3 + √3) × (2/√3 + 1/√3) × (1 − 1/2) = (4/√3) × (3/√3) × (1/2).

Expression = (4/√3) × √3 × 1/2 = 2.

Check options for θ = 30°: cosec 30° = 1/sin 30° = 1/(1/2) = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is cosec θ.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The expression (tan θ + cot θ) (sec θ + tan θ) (1 − sin θ) for 0° **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Identities

Trigonometric ratios are related by reciprocals: cosec θ = 1/sin θ, sec θ = 1/cos θ, and cot θ = 1/tan θ.

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental identities include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Quotient Identities

The tangent and cotangent functions can be expressed as ratios: tan θ = sin θ/cos θ and cot θ = cos θ/sin θ.</p

questions.question: 70% of the students in a school are boys. If the number of girls is 345, then the total number of students is ________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Percentage is always 100%.

If Boys = 70%, then Girls = 100% − 70% = 30%.

Given 30% (Girls) → 345.

Total Students (100%) = (345 ÷ 30) × 100 = 11.5 × 100 = 1150.

**∴ The correct answer is 1150 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Percentage of boys = 70%

Number of girls = 345

**Formula Used:**

Total Value = (Given Part Value ÷ Percentage of Part) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6507fe317c1ff8b78559add6d2a3295aca20b6792ba0d382423bf70985bdd19f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Students percentage = 100%

⇒ Girls percentage = 100% − 70% = 30%

⇒ Let the total number of students be X.

⇒ 30% of X = 345

⇒ (30 ÷ 100) × X = 345

⇒ X = (345 × 100) ÷ 30

⇒ X = 11.5 × 100

⇒ X = 1150

**∴ The correct answer is 1150 students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage to Fraction Conversion

To convert a percentage to a fraction, divide it by 100. Example: 70% = 70/100 = 7/10. This helps in quick ratio-based calculations.

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by a% and then by b%, the effective change is [a + b + (a×b)/100] %.

Base Change Property

If A is x% more than B, then B is [x ÷ (100 + x)] × 100% less than A.</p

questions.question: If A : B = 8 : 9 and B : C = 6 : 7 then find the ratio among A, B, and C.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To combine A : B = 8 : 9 and B : C = 6 : 7, make the common term B equal.

Multiply the first ratio by 2 and the second ratio by 3 to reach the LCM of 9 and 6, which is 18.

A : B = 8 × 2 : 9 × 2 = 16 : 18

B : C = 6 × 3 : 7 × 3 = 18 : 21

Combine the ratios: A : B : C = 16 : 18 : 21.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 : 18 : 21.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 8 : 9

B : C = 6 : 7

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bf8891aa1dba67086769d6327c64fd658894c3f697e56dc87456d61bdbc2212.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ A / B = 8 / 9

⇒ B / C = 6 / 7

⇒ To join them, B must have the same value. LCM(9, 6) = 18.

⇒ A : B = (8 × 2) : (9 × 2) = 16 : 18

⇒ B : C = (6 × 3) : (7 × 3) = 18 : 21

⇒ Therefore, A : B : C = 16 : 18 : 21.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 : 18 : 21.**

**__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

For ratios a:b and c:d, the compound ratio is (a × c) : (b × d).

Duplicate and Triplicate Ratio

Duplicate ratio of a:b is a² : b² and Triplicate ratio is a³ : b³.

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is √(a × b).</p

questions.question: The price of an article is reduced by 35%. How much should be the new price increased to get the original price?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To restore a value after a reduction of r%, apply the recovery formula:

Required Increase % = [Reduction / (100 − Reduction)] × 100

⇒ Required Increase % = [35 / (100 − 35)] × 100

⇒ (35 / 65) × 100 = (7 / 13) × 100 = 700 / 13 = 53 11/13 %

**∴ The correct answer is 53 11/13 %.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduction in price = 35%

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = (Difference / Initial Value) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9334c5cf628eaa16551f13c89188cacb15546360c39a0a5796331fe57f59f79e.png] 

⇒ Let the original price of the article be ₹100.

⇒ Reduced Price = 100 − 35% of 100 = ₹65.

⇒ To get back to the original price, the increase needed = 100 − 65 = ₹35.

⇒ This increase of ₹35 is required on the new price of ₹65.

⇒ Required Percentage Increase = (35 / 65) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage Increase = (7 / 13) × 100 = 700 / 13 = 53 11/13 %

**∴ The correct answer is 53 11/13 %.**

**__Additional Information__**

Base Change Property

If a value is decreased by x%, to restore it to the original value, it must be increased by [x / (100 − x)] × 100%.

Price-Consumption Relation

If the price of a commodity decreases by r%, the increase in consumption required to keep the expenditure same is [r / (100 − r)] × 100%.

Successive Percentage Change

The net percentage change for two successive changes of a% and b% is given by the formula: [a + b + (a × b) / 100]%.

questions.question: A swimming pool is constructed in the shape of a right-angled triangle. One side is five-third of the length of the second side (leaving the longest side). If the management decides to increase the length of one side by 4 m and decrease the second side by 2 m such that the area of the swimming pool remains the same, then what was the length of one side before the alteration happened?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of sides (excluding hypotenuse) = 5 : 3.

Let the sides be 5x and 3x. Area = (1/2) × 5x × 3x = 7.5x².

According to the condition: (5x + 4)(3x − 2) = 15x² (since area is halved by 2).

⇒ 15x² − 10x + 12x − 8 = 15x².

⇒ 2x = 8 ⇒ x = 4.

Sides are: 5 × 4 = 20 m and 3 × 4 = 12 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: Side₁ = (5/3) × Side₂.

Formula: Area of right-angled triangle = (1/2) × Base × Height.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dd5b9bb9c9f2404975d12abfa55dba03126f11e85c0c52e0237a2da9ee25861.png] 

Let the second side be 3x and the first side be 5x.

⇒ Initial Area = (1/2) × 5x × 3x = 7.5x² m².

⇒ New sides after alteration = (5x + 4) and (3x − 2).

⇒ New Area = (1/2) × (5x + 4) × (3x − 2).

⇒ Since Area remains same: (1/2) × 5x × 3x = (1/2) × (5x + 4) × (3x − 2).

⇒ 15x² = 15x² − 10x + 12x − 8.

⇒ 2x = 8.

⇒ x = 4.

⇒ Length of Side 1 = 5 × 4 = 20 m.

⇒ Length of Side 2 = 3 × 4 = 12 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagoras Theorem

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the hypotenuse is equal to the sum of the squares of the other two sides: a² + b² = c².

Heron’s Formula

For any triangle with sides a, b, and c, Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)], where s = (a + b + c)/2.

Triangle Area Property

If the product of the base and height remains constant, the area of the triangle remains unchanged.</p

questions.question: The algebraic sum of the deviations of a set of n values from their mean is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The arithmetic mean is the balance point of any distribution.

By definition, the sum of values above the mean equals the sum of values below the mean.

Mathematically, Σ(xᵢ − Mean) always equals zero.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** A set of n values x₁, x₂, x₃, ..., xₙ. Let their arithmetic mean be x̄.

**Formula Used:** Arithmetic Mean (x̄) = (Σxᵢ) ÷ n ⇒ Σxᵢ = n × x̄

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5cc7abce196525499ec7f3f1172a5ee53251461dead6af1913b809b4138b14be.png] 

The sum of deviations from the mean is expressed as:

⇒ S = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)

⇒ S = (x₁ − x̄) + (x₂ − x̄) + ... + (xₙ − x̄)

⇒ S = (x₁ + x₂ + ... + xₙ) − (x̄ + x̄ + ... + n times)

⇒ S = Σxᵢ − (n × x̄)

Since Σxᵢ = n × x̄:

⇒ S = (n × x̄) − (n × x̄)

⇒ S = 0

**∴ The correct answer is 0.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Squares of Deviations

The sum of the squares of deviations of a set of values is minimum when taken from the arithmetic mean. i.e., Σ(xᵢ − A)² is least when A = x̄.

Sum of Absolute Deviations

The sum of the absolute deviations (ignoring signs) of a set of values is minimum when taken from the median. i.e., Σ|xᵢ − A| is least when A = Median.

Variance Formula

Variance (σ²) is the average of the squared deviations from the mean: σ² = [Σ(xᵢ − x̄)²] ÷ n.</p

questions.question: A policeman notices a thief from a distance of 300 m. The thief starts running and the policeman chases him. The thief and the policeman run at the speeds of 10 km/h and 12 km/h, respectively. What will be the distance between them (in m) after 6 minutes?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of policeman with respect to thief = 12 − 10 = 2 km/h.

Relative speed in m/min = (2 × 1000) ÷ 60 = 100/3 m/min.

Relative distance covered in 6 minutes = (100/3) × 6 = 200 m.

Remaining distance between them = Initial distance − Distance covered = 300 − 200 = 100 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 100 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance between Policeman and Thief = 300 m

Speed of Thief (Vₜ) = 10 km/h

Speed of Policeman (Vₚ) = 12 km/h

Time (t) = 6 minutes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67017652b905e1ab2062f12dedf416887d74ecec82a8cbcd4837817a335490bf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = Vₚ − Vₜ = 12 − 10 = 2 km/h

⇒ To convert km/h to m/s: 2 × (5/18) = 5/9 m/s

⇒ Time in seconds = 6 × 60 = 360 seconds

⇒ Relative distance covered in 6 min = Relative Speed × Time

⇒ Distance covered = (5/9) × 360 = 5 × 40 = 200 m

⇒ Distance between them after 6 min = Initial Gap − Relative distance covered

⇒ Remaining distance = 300 − 200 = 100 m

**∴ The correct answer is 100 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Speed Unit Conversion

To convert Speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Catching Time Formula

Time taken to catch the thief = (Initial distance between them) ÷ (Relative Speed).</p

questions.question:
What is the simplified form of the following expression?

{( {x - (1)/(y)} )³} + {( {x + (1)/(y)} )³}
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Use Algebraic Identity: (a − b)³ + (a + b)³ = 2a(a² + 3b²).

Here, a = x and b = 1/y.

Substitute: 2(x)[(x)² + 3(1/y)²].

Simplified result: 2x(x² + 3/y²).

**∴ The correct answer is 2x(x² + 3/y²).**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: (x − 1/y)³ + (x + 1/y)³

Formula used: (a − b)³ = a³ − 3a²b + 3ab² − b³ and (a + b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³

⇒ Expansion of (x − 1/y)³ = x³ − 3x²/y + 3x/y² − 1/y³

⇒ Expansion of (x + 1/y)³ = x³ + 3x²/y + 3x/y² + 1/y³

⇒ Summing both expressions: (x³ − 3x²/y + 3x/y² − 1/y³) + (x³ + 3x²/y + 3x/y² + 1/y³)

⇒ Combining like terms: (x³ + x³) + (−3x²/y + 3x²/y) + (3x/y² + 3x/y²) + (−1/y³ + 1/y³)

⇒ Result = 2x³ + 6x/y²

⇒ Taking 2x common: 2x(x² + 3/y²)

**∴ The correct answer is 2x(x² + 3/y²).**

**__Additional Information__**

Cubic Identity (Difference)

(a + b)³ − (a − b)³ = 2b(3a² + b²) = 6a²b + 2b³

Algebraic Square Identities

(a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²) and (a + b)² − (a − b)² = 4ab

Sum and Difference of Cubes

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) and a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)</p

questions.question: The nearest number which is greater to 87501, and is completely divisible by 765 is :
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the remainder of 87501 when divided by 765.

Remainder = 87501 (mod 765) = 291.

To find the next greater divisible number, add (Divisor − Remainder) to the number.

Required Number = 87501 + (765 − 291) = 87501 + 474 = 87975.

**∴ The correct answer is 87975.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Original Number = 87501

Divisor = 765

**Formula Used:**

Smallest number greater than N divisible by D = N + (D − (N mod D))

**Calculations:**

⇒ Divide 87501 by 765 to find the remainder:

⇒ 87501 ÷ 765 = 114 with a remainder of 291

⇒ 765 × 114 = 87210 (largest divisible number less than 87501)

⇒ The next divisible number = 87210 + 765

⇒ Required number = 87975

⇒ Verification: 87975 ÷ 765 = 115 (exactly divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is 87975.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility and Remainders

When a number N is divided by D, the remainder R always satisfies 0 ≤ R < D. To make N divisible by D, one can either subtract R from N or add (D − R) to N.

Divisibility Rule for Composite Numbers

For a number to be divisible by 765, it must be divisible by its prime factors. Since 765 = 3² × 5 × 17, the number must be divisible by 5 (ends in 0 or 5) and 9 (sum of digits is a multiple of 9).</p

questions.question:
In the following figure, ΔABC is an equilateral triangle of side 12 cm. If AD, BE and CF are medians of ΔABC, then AD + BE + CF = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69f43e978826f7f4388a2288a0bed0e1fc50f8d9de5317636db33cef0001b965.png]
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

In an equilateral triangle, all three medians are equal in length.

Length of one median = Altitude = (√3 ÷ 2) × side

Given side = 12 cm ⇒ Median = (√3 ÷ 2) × 12 = 6√3 cm

Sum of three medians = 3 × 6√3 = 18√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18√3 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Side of equilateral ΔABC (a) = 12 cm. AD, BE, and CF are medians.

**Formula:** Length of median in an equilateral triangle = (√3 / 2) × a

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ce275f7c54132cc73847fbf385c74f53ff260a30f4720ddb1756646eb4b3d7f.png] 

⇒ In ΔABC, AD is the median to side BC.

⇒ AD = (√3 / 2) × 12

⇒ AD = 6√3 cm

⇒ Since it is an equilateral triangle, medians AD = BE = CF.

⇒ BE = 6√3 cm and CF = 6√3 cm

⇒ Sum = AD + BE + CF

⇒ Sum = 6√3 + 6√3 + 6√3

⇒ Sum = 18√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 18√3 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Equilateral Triangle Medians

In an equilateral triangle, the medians, altitudes, angle bisectors, and perpendicular bisectors of sides are all identical in length and position.

Area and Inradius

Area = (√3 / 4) × side². Inradius (r) = a / (2√3) and Circumradius (R) = a / √3.

Centroid Property

The centroid divides each median in the ratio 2 : 1. For a median of length 6√3, the segments are 4√3 (from vertex) and 2√3 (to base).</p

questions.question: The average output of n machines is k units per day. If one of the machines is excluded, whose output is 780 units per day, the average output will decrease by 30 units. Instead, if one dead machine is included, the average output will decrease by 90 units. What is the total output of n machines?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Case 1: Removal of 780 units machine reduces average by 30 ⇒ 780 − k = 30(n − 1)

Case 2: Addition of 0 units machine reduces average by 90 ⇒ k − 0 = 90(n + 1)

Substitute k = 90n + 90 in first equation: 780 − (90n + 90) = 30n − 30

690 − 90n = 30n − 30 ⇒ 120n = 720 ⇒ n = 6

Average k = 90(6 + 1) = 630 units. Total output = 6 × 630 = 3780 units.

**∴ The correct answer is 3780 units.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of machines = n | Average output = k units/day

Value of machine excluded = 780 units | Value of machine included = 0 units

**Formula Used:**

Total Output = Number of Machines × Average Output

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10e161962e90aac1ae67befc98447fa496d6a6f63a1e5ada63278f606d188097.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total initial output = n × k

⇒ When 780 is excluded: (nk − 780) ÷ (n − 1) = k − 30

⇒ nk − 780 = (n − 1)(k − 30) = nk − 30n − k + 30

⇒ 30n + k = 810 ... (Eq. 1)

⇒ When a dead machine (0 units) is included: (nk + 0) ÷ (n + 1) = k − 90

⇒ nk = (n + 1)(k − 90) = nk − 90n + k − 90

⇒ k − 90n = 90 ⇒ k = 90n + 90 ... (Eq. 2)

⇒ Substituting (Eq. 2) in (Eq. 1): 30n + (90n + 90) = 810

⇒ 120n = 720 ⇒ n = 6

⇒ k = 90(6) + 90 = 630

⇒ Total Output = nk = 6 × 630 = 3780 units

**∴ The correct answer is 3780 units.**

**__Additional Information__**

Net Deviation Principle

In any average problem, the sum of deviations from the average is always zero. If an item is added or removed, the total change in the sum equals the deviation of that item from the original average.

Impact of Adding Zero

When a zero-value item is added to a set, the total sum remains constant, but the average decreases because the denominator (count) increases: New Avg = Old Sum ÷ (n + 1).

Average Property

If every element in a set is increased or decreased by a constant value 'x', the average also increases or decreases by 'x' respectively.</p

questions.question: Shyam is travelling on his cycle and has calculated to reach point 'A' at 2 PM If he travels at 10 kmph. he will reach there at 12 noon if he travels at 15 kmph. At what speed must he travel to reach "A" at 1 PM:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The target time (1 PM) is the exact midpoint between 12 noon and 2 PM.

When the distance is constant and the required time is the arithmetic mean of two given times, the required speed is the Harmonic Mean of the two speeds.

Required Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Required Speed = (2 × 10 × 15) ÷ (10 + 15) = 300 ÷ 25 = 12 kmph.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 kmph.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed 1 (S₁) = 10 kmph (Reaches at 2 PM)

Speed 2 (S₂) = 15 kmph (Reaches at 12 noon)

Time difference (ΔT) = 2 PM − 12 noon = 2 hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4db5e6eecb572e5bc20f81cff132d018f53e01f87ef967da4f65396d5593481.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Distance (D) = (S₁ × S₂ × ΔT) ÷ (S₂ − S₁)

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculations:**

⇒ D = (10 × 15 × 2) ÷ (15 − 10)

⇒ D = 300 ÷ 5 = 60 km.

⇒ Time taken at 10 kmph = 60 ÷ 10 = 6 hours.

⇒ If he reaches at 2 PM after 6 hours, he started at = 2 PM − 6 hours = 8 AM.

⇒ To reach at 1 PM, target duration = 1 PM − 8 AM = 5 hours.

⇒ Required Speed = Total Distance ÷ Target Duration

⇒ Required Speed = 60 ÷ 5 = 12 kmph.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 kmph.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distance-Speed Inverse Relation

When distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (S₁/S₂ = T₂/T₁).

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

If a person covers equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Speed Units Conversion

To convert kmph to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to kmph, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: If {( {a + (1)/(a) + 3} )²} = 16, where a is a non-zero real number, then find the value of a² + (1)/({{a²)}}.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

(a + 1/a + 3) = ±√16 = ±4

For real 'a', the absolute value of (a + 1/a) must be ≥ 2.

If a + 1/a + 3 = 4 → a + 1/a = 1 (Impossible for real 'a')

If a + 1/a + 3 = −4 → a + 1/a = −7

a² + 1/a² = (a + 1/a)² − 2 = (−7)² − 2 = 47

**∴ The correct answer is 47.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (a + 1/a + 3)² = 16

**Formula used:** (x + 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² + 2

⇒ (a + 1/a + 3)² = 16

⇒ a + 1/a + 3 = ±4

⇒ Case 1: a + 1/a + 3 = 4 ⇒ a + 1/a = 1

⇒ For real number 'a', the discriminant of a² − a + 1 = 0 is (−1)² − 4(1)(1) = −3, so 'a' is not real.

⇒ Case 2: a + 1/a + 3 = −4 ⇒ a + 1/a = −7

⇒ Squaring both sides: (a + 1/a)² = (−7)²

⇒ a² + 1/a² + 2 = 49

⇒ a² + 1/a² = 49 − 2 = 47

**∴ The correct answer is 47.**

**__Additional Information__**

Range of x + 1/x

For any non-zero real number 'x', the value of (x + 1/x) always satisfies |x + 1/x| ≥ 2.

Algebraic Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2 and x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.

Nature of Roots

For a quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0, roots are real only if the discriminant D = b² − 4ac ≥ 0.</p

questions.question: If A ∶ B ∶ C = 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 5, then sqrt{A²+B²}:sqrt{C²-B²}{} is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**5 : 3**__
**__Key Points__**
__

• Given the ratio **A : B : C = 3 : 4 : 5**, we can assume the values of the variables to be **A = 3k**, **B = 4k**, and **C = 5k**, where k is a non-zero constant.

• The problem asks for the ratio of **√(A² + B²)** to **√(C² − B²)**.

• First, calculate the value of the first term:

**√(A² + B²)** = √((3k)² + (4k)²)

= √(9k² + 16k²)

= √(25k²) = **5k**.

• Next, calculate the value of the second term:

**√(C² − B²)** = √((5k)² − (4k)²)

= √(25k² − 16k²)

= √(9k²) = **3k**.

• The required ratio is **5k : 3k**. Since k is a common factor in both terms, it can be cancelled out, resulting in the simplified ratio **5 : 3**.

• Therefore, the expression **√(A² + B²) : √(C² − B²)** simplifies to **5 : 3**, which corresponds to **Option 3**.

**Additional Information__**

• **Ratio and Proportion**: A ratio is a way of comparing quantities of the same kind by division. When values are given in a ratio like 3 : 4 : 5, they can be treated as absolute values (3, 4, 5) for homogeneous expressions because the common multiplier cancels out.

• **Pythagorean Triplets**: The numbers 3, 4, and 5 form the most basic **Pythagorean Triplet**, where 3² + 4² = 5². This relationship is often used in geometry and trigonometry.

• **Properties of Square Roots**: It is important to remember that **√(x² + y²)** is not equal to x + y. The operations must be performed under the root before the square root is extracted.
</ul

questions.question: Which of the following is largest among (125)^(1)/(6), (11)^(1)/(3), (12)^(1)/(6), (5)^(1)/(4) ?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

LCM of denominators of powers (6, 3, 6, 4) is 12.

Raise all values to the 12th power:

((125)¹/⁶)¹² = 125² = 15625

((11)¹/³)¹² = 11⁴ = 14641

((12)¹/⁶)¹² = 12² = 144; ((5)¹/⁴)¹² = 5³ = 125

Comparing results: 15625 > 14641 > 144 > 125.

**∴ The correct answer is (125)¹/⁶.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** (125)¹/⁶, (11)¹/³, (12)¹/⁶, (5)¹/⁴

**Formula:** To compare a¹/ⁿ and b¹/m, convert them to a common index by finding the LCM of denominators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71aad04defbc2e72676231319f02ac3f5b8e8d7a39beebd013a19c1fbbe61805.png] 

⇒ Convert all powers to a common denominator 12:

⇒ (125)¹/⁶ = (125)²/¹² = (125²)¹/¹² = (15625)¹/¹²

⇒ (11)¹/³ = (11)⁴/¹² = (11⁴)¹/¹² = (14641)¹/¹²

⇒ (12)¹/⁶ = (12)²/¹² = (12²)¹/¹² = (144)¹/¹²

⇒ (5)¹/⁴ = (5)³/¹² = (5³)¹/¹² = (125)¹/¹²

⇒ Since 15625 > 14641 > 144 > 125, the largest value is (15625)¹/¹².

**∴ The correct answer is (125)¹/⁶.**

**__Additional Information__**

Comparing Surds of Different Indices

To compare numbers like ⁿ√a and m√b, find the LCM of n and m. Raise both numbers to the power of the LCM to eliminate the radical signs.

Laws of Indices

Important properties include (am)ⁿ = am×ⁿ and a¹/ⁿ = ⁿ√a. These are essential for simplifying expressions before comparison.

Ascending and Descending Order

Once terms are converted to the same index (e.g., x¹/¹²), they can be sorted based on the magnitude of the base x.</p

questions.question:
In the adjoining figure line l is parallel to m . What is the value of 2x + y?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91717aa2833a879028f59e02baed008c28241c0ff4804cd68fc4c7bd8302ced5.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify x = 75° as it is the alternate interior angle to the given 75° angle.

Identify y = 120° from the geometric properties of the transversal (supplementary angle to 60°).

Substitute these values into the expression: 2(75°) + 120°.

2x + y = 150° + 120° = 270°.

**∴ The correct answer is 270°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Line l is parallel to line m (l ∥ m). The angles marked are 75°, x, and y.

**Formula Used:**

1. Alternate interior angles are equal when two parallel lines are cut by a transversal.

2. Interior angles on the same side of the transversal are supplementary (sum = 180°).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb9ff17cdfae143d63743ef1c5dd1c40fa0702bddfabf5c2430cdcf72a4962df.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ By the property of alternate interior angles, the angle x corresponds to the given angle 75°.

⇒ x = 75°

⇒ Based on the geometric setup and co-interior angle properties, the value of y is 120°.

⇒ We need to find the value of 2x + y.

⇒ 2x + y = 2 × 75° + 120°

⇒ 2x + y = 150° + 120°

⇒ 2x + y = 270°

**∴ The correct answer is 270°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alternate Interior Angles

When two parallel lines are intersected by a transversal, the pairs of angles on opposite sides of the transversal and between the parallel lines are equal.

Co-interior Angles

Angles on the same side of the transversal and inside the parallel lines sum to 180° (∠1 + ∠2 = 180°).

Vertical Opposite Angles

When two lines intersect, the angles opposite to each other at the vertex are always equal.</p

questions.question: B and C alone can complete a piece of work in 5 days and 15 days respectively. They started the work together but after a few days B left the work and C alone completed the remaining work in 3 days. After how many days from the beginning did B leave the job?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(5, 15) = 15 units.

Efficiency of B = 3 units/day, Efficiency of C = 1 unit/day.

Work done by C alone in the last 3 days = 3 × 1 = 3 units.

Remaining work done by (B + C) together = 15 − 3 = 12 units.

Number of days B worked = 12 ÷ (3 + 1) = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by B = 5 days

Time taken by C = 15 days

Time C worked alone at the end = 3 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

Combined Efficiency = Efficiency of B + Efficiency of C

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 B
 5
 15
 3
 
 

 C
 15
 1
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work (LCM of 5 and 15) = 15 units

⇒ Efficiency of B = 15 ÷ 5 = 3 units/day

⇒ Efficiency of C = 15 ÷ 15 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Work completed by C alone in the last 3 days = 1 × 3 = 3 units

⇒ Remaining work completed by B and C together = 15 − 3 = 12 units

⇒ Combined efficiency of B and C = 3 + 1 = 4 units/day

⇒ Number of days B and C worked together = 12 ÷ 4 = 3 days

⇒ Since B left after the combined work period, B worked for 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Similar to Time and Work, but work done can be negative (leakage or outlet pipe). Efficiency of filling pipe is positive, and outlet pipe is negative.

Work and Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the actual work done by each person. If they work for the same time, the ratio of wages is the ratio of efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When work is done on alternate days, calculate the total work done in one full cycle (e.g., 2 days) and then divide total work by cycle work to find total time.</p

questions.question: Manoj gave Rs 4000 to Raj on simple interest at a rate of 19% for 3 years. How much money Raj will give back to Manoj after 3 years?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Interest Percentage = Rate × Time = 19% × 3 = 57%

Total Amount Percentage = 100% (Principal) + 57% (Interest) = 157%

Total Amount = 157% of ₹4000

⇒ Total Amount = 1.57 × 4000 = ₹6280

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4000

Rate of Interest (R) = 19% per annum

Time (T) = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = Principal + Simple Interest

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/970bd3cd560e74befa0cfcc495aa32908c74c8c01bfc004b46e4ba917f6af6c3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (4000 × 19 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 40 × 57

⇒ SI = ₹2280

⇒ Amount = P + SI

⇒ Amount = 4000 + 2280

⇒ Amount = ₹6280

**∴ The correct answer is ₹6280.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Property

Simple interest is calculated only on the principal amount, hence it remains constant for every year if the rate and principal are unchanged.

Amount in SI

The final amount can be directly calculated using A = P(1 + RT/100).

SI vs CI Difference

For the first year, if the interest is compounded annually, SI and CI are equal. From the second year onwards, CI becomes greater than SI.

questions.question: A vertical cross-section along the middle of a cylinder with a height of 15 cm and a base radius of 7 cm is cut out. Find the area of the cross-section portion in cm².
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Vertical cross-section of a cylinder along the middle is a rectangle.

Dimensions of this rectangle: Width = Diameter (2r) and Length = Height (h).

Width = 2 × 7 = 14 cm

Area = Width × Height = 14 × 15

Area = 210 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 210 cm².**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given:

Radius of cylinder (r) = 7 cm

Height of cylinder (h) = 15 cm

Formula: Area of vertical cross-section = 2 × r × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94d9a9d60338322e80966921c131f93ed6629485e5ed17f8c23b9be293b759cb.png] 

⇒ Diameter of the base (d) = 2 × Radius

⇒ d = 2 × 7 = 14 cm

⇒ The vertical cross-section is a rectangle with length 15 cm and breadth 14 cm.

⇒ Area of the rectangle = Length × Breadth

⇒ Area = 15 × 14

⇒ Area = 210 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 210 cm².**

**__Additional Information__**

Horizontal Cross-section

A horizontal cross-section (parallel to the base) of a cylinder is always a circle with area πr².

Volume of Cylinder

The volume of a cylinder is calculated as V = πr²h, representing the total capacity.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The TSA of a cylinder includes the curved surface and two circular bases: TSA = 2πrh + 2πr² = 2πr(h + r).

Diagonal of Vertical Cross-section

The diagonal of the rectangular cross-section can be found using √((2r)² + h²).</p

questions.question: When asked to divide a number by 6, Rani has divided it by 9 and she got the quotient as 21 and remainder as 3. Realising her mistake, later she divided it by 6. What will be the quotient and remainder?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Original Number = (Incorrect Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

Number = (9 × 21) + 3 = 189 + 3 = 192

New Calculation: 192 ÷ 6 = 32

Remainder = 192 − (6 × 32) = 0

**∴ The correct answer is Quotient - 32, Remainder - 0.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Divisor₁ = 9, Quotient₁ = 21, Remainder₁ = 3, Divisor₂ = 6

Formula: Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0702ef7cd2908b7c2c47da9880f368b0a5bb5ed6801ce5a668fcf124eca14ad2.png] 

⇒ Original Number = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

⇒ Number = (9 × 21) + 3

⇒ Number = 189 + 3 = 192

⇒ New Quotient = 192 ÷ 6 = 32

⇒ New Remainder = 192 − (6 × 32) = 0

**∴ The correct answer is Quotient - 32, Remainder - 0.**

**__Additional Information__**

The Division Algorithm

For any integer (dividend) and a non-zero integer (divisor), the relationship is Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder.

Remainder Condition

The remainder (r) must always satisfy the condition 0 ≤ r < |divisor|. If r = 0, the dividend is exactly divisible by the divisor.

Verification

To verify a division result, multiply the quotient by the divisor and add the remainder; the sum must equal the original dividend.</p
